# möbius for macOS 0.17.2

Bundles gateway **0.17.2** and adds the A2Agent provider icon to setup and model selection. Requires protocol **100**.

Read the [gateway upgrade instructions](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/releases/tag/mobius-gateway-v0.17.1) before replacing a 0.16.50 gateway. Existing 0.17.1 state needs no conversion.
